item.title: Yukio 5.4
item.description: Mac 5.4 Preview 3 (build 63): clearer assistant/chat navigation, Claude chat identity fixes, immediately saved explanation providers, faster Codex short explanations, maintenance safeguards and Python 3.12.16. Full independent first-run acceptance remains paused and incomplete. Apple silicon; ad-hoc signed, not notarized. Windows and cloud Cowork deferred.
Mac 5.4 Preview 3（构建 63）：整理助手与聊天列表，修复 Claude 聊天重复、解释来源保存和 Codex 短解释超时，补充维护机制及 Python 3.12.16。完整独立首次使用验收仍暂停且未完成。Apple 芯片专用，临时签名、未公证；Windows 与云端 Cowork 暂缓。

item.title: Yukio 5.4
item.description: Mac 5.4 Preview 2 (build 56): fixes first-launch access, assistant installation/sign-in checks, empty-chat status and the Tahoe installer. Includes updated bilingual guides. Full first-run acceptance is incomplete; revised-package and signed-in real-task checks remain pending. Apple silicon; ad-hoc signed, not notarized. Windows and cloud Cowork deferred.
Mac 5.4 预览版 2（构建 56）：修复首次入口、助手安装与登录检查、空白聊天状态及 Tahoe 安装窗口，更新中英文指南。完整首次使用验收未完成；修复包独立复验及登录后的真实任务仍待验。仅 Apple silicon；临时签名、未公证。Windows 与云端 Cowork 暂缓。
